summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.

FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.

Never request review on a branch that changes ledgerly/storage/queries.py until its EXAMPLES.md file contains fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for every modified query.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`, which sends reminders to customers who already paid. Router splitting is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disabling idempotency middleware causes duplicate staging invoices.
- Do not assert scheduler correctness from local formatted time alone; it obscured the UTC defect.
- Do not retain shared batch references; charged events must be removed without breaking retry retention.

## Recent work
Removed worker batch aliasing and unused `_last_batch` retention. Added a five-event isolation regression; worker tests pass (41), and the full suite passes (118 passed, 7 skipped). Tracemalloc now peaks at 7.3 MiB with no pending events. Terraform procedure steps 3–4 also passed.
